main.description: Reserve a KEM key on this PDS, for an entryway to name in the genesis PLC operation of an account it creates here. PDS-internal. Unlike the spaces migration endpoints, it is not temporary: entryway signups use it.

did.description: The DID to reserve the key for, if already known.

kemKey.description: The public key of the reserved KEM keypair, as a did:key.
